Yes — `find_logs` uses `p.is_file()` (line 12), which follows symlinks, so a symlink pointing at a regular file is treated as a log and compressed (`compress` reads through it, then `unlink()` deletes the link, leaving the target).

Caveat if you use a `**` pattern: `Path.glob` does not recurse *into* symlinked directories, so only symlinks matched directly at a walked level show up.
